verses.sanskrit:
और्व उवाच।
              उक्तवानस्मि यां क्रोधात्प्रतिज्ञां पितरस्तदा। सर्वलोकविनाशाय न सा मे वितथा भवेत्॥१॥
verses.english: Arjuna said : O Pitris, the vow I uttered in anger for the destruction of all the worlds must not be in vain.
verses.bhavadeepa: मावधीरिति । क्षत्रियान् तदनियंतृत्वेनानपराधिनः । सप्तलोकान् भूरादींश्च मा वधीः किं तु तपःसंभृतं तेजो दूषयन्तं क्रोधं जहि । पाठान्तरमुपेक्ष्यम् ॥२२॥

verses.sanskrit: वृथारोषप्रतिज्ञो वै नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे। अनिस्तीर्णो हि मां रोषो दहेदग्निरिवारणिम्॥२॥
verses.english: I cannot to be one whose anger and vows are fruitless. This my anger will certainly consume me (if I do not accomplish my vow), as fire consumes the dry wood.

verses.sanskrit: यो हि कारणतः क्रोधं संजातं क्षन्तुमर्हति। नालं स मनुजः सम्यक् त्रिवर्गं परिरक्षितुम्॥३॥
verses.english: The men, who suppresses his anger excited by a just cause, becomes incapable of duly compassing the Three varga (Dharma, Artha and Kama.)

verses.sanskrit: अशिष्टानां नियन्ता हि शिष्टानां परिरक्षिता। स्थाने रोषः प्रयुक्तः स्यान्नृपैः सर्वजिगीषुभिः॥४॥
verses.english: The wrath, that the kings, desirous of subjugating the whole world, display, has its use. It serves to restrain the wicked and protect the honest.
verses.bhavadeepa: वृथोत्पन्नः क्रोधो जेतव्यो न तु सकारणक इत्याह यो हीति ॥३॥

verses.sanskrit: अश्रौषमहमूरुस्थो गर्भशय्यागतस्तदा। आरावं मातृवर्गस्य भृगूणां क्षत्रियैर्वधे॥५॥
verses.english: When I was lying unborn within my mother and other women of the Bhrigu race as they were being massacred by the Kshatriyas.

verses.sanskrit: संहारो हि यदा लोके भृगूणां क्षत्रियाधमैः। आगर्भोच्छेदनात्क्रान्तस्तदा मां मन्युराविशत्॥६॥
verses.english: O Pitris, when those wretches, the Kshatriyas, were exterminating the Bhrigus together with the unborn children to their race, anger filled my soul.

verses.sanskrit: संपूर्णकोशाः किल मे मातरः पितरस्तथा। भयात्सर्वेषु लोकेषु नाधिजग्मुः परायणम्॥७॥
verses.english: My mother and the other women of our race, each in a state of advanced pregnancy and my father also, though exceedingly afflic did not get a protector in all the world.

verses.sanskrit: तान्भृगूणां यदा दारान्कश्चिन्नाभ्युपपद्यत। माता तदा दधारेयमूरुणैकेन मां शुभा॥८॥
verses.english: When the Bhrigu women did not find a single protector, my blessed mother held me (hidden) in one of her thighs.
verses.bhavadeepa: तर्हि क्षत्रिया एव वध्या न तु लोका इत्यत आह । संपूर्णेति द्वाभ्याम् । कोशो जरायुरूपा मांसपेशी । संपूर्णः कोशो यासां ताः । परिपक्वगर्भा इत्यर्थः । ‘कोशोऽर्थसञ्चये मांसपेश्याम्’ इति विश्वः । संपूर्णशोका इत्यपि पठन्ति । लोकैः सत्यपि सामर्थ्ये मन्मातॄणां त्राणं न कृतमतस्तेऽपि वध्या एवेत्यर्थः ॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिषेद्धा हि पापस्य यदा लोकेषु विद्यते। तदा सर्वेषु लोकेषु पापकृन्नोपपद्यते॥९॥
verses.english: If there be a punisher of crimes in the world, no one in all the worlds could dare commit a crime.

verses.sanskrit: यदा तु प्रतिषेद्धारं पापो न लभते क्वचित्। तिष्ठन्ति बहवो लोकास्तदा पापेषु कर्मसु॥१०॥
verses.english: If sin does not find any punisher, then many men live in sinful acts.
verses.bhavadeepa: एतदेवोपपादयति प्रतिषेद्धेति । प्रतिषेद्धरि सति पापकृदेव नोपलभ्यते । असति तु सर्वोपि पाप एव प्रवर्तत इति श्लोकद्वयार्थः ॥९॥

verses.sanskrit: जानन्नपि च यः पापं शक्तिमान्न नियच्छति। ईशः सन्सोऽपि तेनैव कर्मणा संप्रयुज्यते॥११॥
verses.english: The man who having power to punish sin, does not do so, knowing that a sin has been committed, is himself defiled by that sin.

verses.sanskrit: राजभिश्चेश्वरैश्चैव यदि वै पितरो मम। शक्तैर्न शकितास्त्रातुमिष्टं मत्वेह जीवितम्॥१२॥
verses.english: The kings and others, who were capable of protecting my fathers, did not protect them, neglecting to perform their duty by giving themselves up to the pleasures of life. Therefore, I have just cause to be enraged. I am the lord of creation, I am incapable of obeying your command.

verses.sanskrit: अत एषामहं क्रुद्धो लोकानामीश्वरो ह्यहम्। भवतां च वचो नालमहं समभिवर्तितुम्॥१३॥
ममापि चेद्भवेदेवमीश्वरस्य सतो महत्। उपेक्षमाणस्य पुनर्लोकानां किल्बिषाद्भयम्॥१४॥
verses.english: Capable as I am of punishing this crime, if I abstain from doing it, men will once more have to undergo a similar persecution.

verses.sanskrit: यश्चायं मन्युजो मेऽग्निर्लोकानादातुमिच्छति। दहेदेष च मामेव निगृहीतः स्वतेजसा॥१५॥
verses.english: The fire of my wrath, which is ready to consume the worlds, if suppressed, will certainly consume me by its own energy.

verses.sanskrit: भवतां च विजानामि सर्वलोकहितेप्सुताम्। तस्माद्विधध्वं यच्छ्रेयो लोकानां मम चेश्वराः॥१६॥
verses.english: O masters, I know you always seek the good of the worlds. Therefore, instruct me as to what may be good to myself or to the worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
पितर ऊचुः।
              य एष मन्युजस्तेऽग्निर्लोकानादातुमिच्छति। अप्सु तं मुञ्च भद्रं ते लोका ह्यप्सु प्रतिष्ठिताः॥१७॥
verses.english: The Pitris said : Throw this fire of your wrath which desires to consume the worlds into the waters. That will do you good. The worlds rest on water.

verses.sanskrit: आपोमयाः सर्वरसाः सर्वमापोमयं जगत्। तस्मादप्सु विमुञ्चेमं क्रोधाग्निं द्विजसत्तम॥१८॥
verses.english: Every juicy substance is full of water; indeed the whole universe is full of water. Therefore, O best of the twice born, throw this your anger into the waters.

verses.sanskrit: अयं तिष्ठतु ते विप्र यदीच्छसि महोदधौ। मन्युजोऽग्निर्दहन्नापो लोका ह्यापोमयाः स्मृताः॥१९॥
verses.english: O Brahmana, if you desire it, let this fire of your wrath remain in the great ocean, consuming its water, for we have heard the worlds are made of water.
verses.bhavadeepa: आपोमया इति । कारणीभूतास्वप्सु दग्धासु लोका अपि दग्धप्राया इत्यर्थः ॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: एवं प्रतिज्ञा सत्येयं तवानघ भविष्यति। न चैवं सामरा लोका गमिष्यन्ति पराभवम्॥२०॥
verses.english: O sinless one, in this way your word will be made true and the worlds with the celestials will not be destroyed.

verses.sanskrit:
वसिष्ठ उवाच।
              ततस्तं क्रोधजं तात और्वोऽग्निं वरुणालये। उत्ससर्ज स चैवाप उपयुङ्क्ते महोदधौ॥२१॥
verses.english: Vasishtha said: Thereupon Aurva threw the fire of his wrath into the abode of Varuna (sea) and that fire consumes the waters of the great ocean.

verses.sanskrit: महद्धयशिरो भूत्वा यत्तद्वेदविदो विदुः। तमग्निमुद्गिरद्वक्त्रात्पिबत्यापो महोदधौ॥२२॥
verses.english: Assuming a greatly fearful head (that of a horse) and emitting fire from its mouth, it consumes the waters of the great ocean. The men learned in the Vedas call it Vadabamukha.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मात्त्वमपि भद्रं ते न लोकान्हन्तुमर्हसि। पराशरं पराँल्लोकाञ्जानञ्ज्ञानवतां वर॥२३॥
verses.english: O Parashara, O foremost of all wise men, you are acquainted with the higher regions, you should not destroy the world.
